data: Were the text-to-text and past-to-text models evaluated for log likelihoods over the same range of volume numbers?

The caption states that the two models were evaluated over the text-to-text and text-to-past k = 80 models of 647 of Darwin's readings. The figure shows two graphs, one for the text-to-text model and one for the past-to-text model. Both graphs have the same x-axis range, which corresponds to the division point (volume number) from 0 to 700. This suggests that the two models were evaluated over the same range of volume numbers. Therefore, the answer is yes, the text-to-text and past-to-text models were evaluated for log likelihoods over the same range of volume numbers.
